protocol.additional_inorganic_note: Unprinted supply sensitivity, including sulfate; not the measured recipe.
protocol.arm_selection: All six reported; no arm selected using outcomes.
protocol.buffer: Supply printed MOPS if the exact exchange exists; otherwise explicitly unrepresented.
protocol.genotype: Exact symbol to canonical gene mapping; production GPR knockout, including isozyme bypasses.
protocol.interpretation: Model-conditional phenotype feasibility; no independent gene attribution or calibrated probability.
protocol.maintenance: Model-native ATPM lower bound; never tuned or disabled.
protocol.missing_components: Record every missing exact exchange; do not substitute related molecules.
protocol.observed_growth: Raw-reconstructed mean OD600 > 0.02; endpoint presence, not growth rate.
protocol.paired_rescue: Supplemented growth and unsupplemented no-growth, at the same strain/environment/arm.
protocol.rate_interpretation: Fixed modeling assumptions, not converted from concentrations or fitted to OD.
protocol.scope: All single-organism assays; no-nitrogen controls reported separately; no outcome filtering.
